sourcePolicy: All questions in this pack are Ready2Go original draft practice items unless an individual record states otherwise. No official JAMB past-question corpus is included. Human subject-matter and answer-key review is required before public release.

questions.question: Which cell structure primarily controls the movement of substances into and out of a cell?
questions.explanation: The cell membrane is selectively permeable and regulates movement into and out of the cell.

questions.question: Which pigment absorbs light energy for photosynthesis in green plants?
questions.explanation: Chlorophyll in chloroplasts absorbs light energy used in photosynthesis.

questions.question: Which plant tissue transports water and dissolved mineral salts from roots?
questions.explanation: Xylem conducts water and minerals mainly from roots towards the shoot.

questions.question: A section of DNA that carries information for a particular inherited characteristic is called a…
questions.explanation: A gene is a DNA sequence associated with a functional product and inherited trait.

questions.question: Organisms that make their own food from inorganic substances are called…
questions.explanation: Producers, such as green plants, form the base of many food chains.

questions.question: Which cell structure contains most of the genetic material in a typical plant cell?
questions.explanation: The nucleus contains chromosomes carrying DNA.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Which organelle releases much of the usable energy during aerobic respiration?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria are a major site of aerobic respiration.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Which pigment absorbs light for photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Chlorophyll captures light energy in chloroplasts.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: A gene is best described as what?

options.A: A DNA sequence associated with a functional product or inherited characteristic

questions.explanation: Genes are units of heredity encoded in DNA.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Which process normally produces two genetically similar daughter cells for growth?
questions.explanation: Mitosis supports growth and repair.

questions.question: Osmosis is the movement of water across a selectively permeable membrane from what?

options.A: High pressure to vacuum in every case
options.C: Higher water potential to lower water potential
options.D: Low temperature to high temperature only

questions.explanation: Osmosis is water movement down a water-potential gradient.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Which blood component primarily transports oxygen?
questions.explanation: Haemoglobin in red blood cells binds oxygen.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: An ecosystem includes which components?

options.A: Living organisms and their physical environment

questions.explanation: Ecosystems include biotic and abiotic components.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: What is the main role of an enzyme in a biochemical reaction?

options.C: To change every substrate into water
options.D: To increase the reaction rate without being used up overall

questions.explanation: Enzymes act as biological catalysts.

questions.question: Pollination in flowering plants is the transfer of pollen from what?
questions.explanation: Pollination places pollen on a receptive stigma.

questions.question: Natural selection tends to favour inherited traits that do what?

options.A: Appear only after an organism dies
options.B: Improve reproductive success in a particular environment

questions.explanation: Traits that improve success can become more common over generations.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Which nutrient is the main readily available energy source in human nutrition?
questions.explanation: Carbohydrates are commonly metabolised for energy.

questions.question: Which organ removes urea from blood to form urine?
questions.explanation: Kidneys filter blood and excrete urea in urine.

questions.question: Which organism is commonly used to make yoghurt by fermentation?
questions.explanation: Lactic acid bacteria ferment lactose to lactic acid.
